messages:
maya: quick thread — proposing a per-route structured-log field whitelist + retention tiers so we stop storing raw prompts in long-term logs
liam: +1. main worry is KV-cache keys leaking PII when we materialize prefix caches for perf
ana: can we do both: whitelist for console preview, and a separate encrypted audit copy for legal with narrower TTL? :thinking_face:
david: yeah, audit copy should be opt-in per-tenant and go to a different silo (no console access). quotas for that copy should be metered (reserved capacity)
maya: rough config prototype below (for discussion). goal: keep logs small for regular telemetry + make console never show full prompt unless explicitly unmasked by audit flow
```yaml
routes:
  - name: chat.complete
    path: /v1/chat/completions
    log_policy:
      preview_fields: [request_id, user_pseudonym, prompt_summary, model, latency_ms]
      full_audit: enabled
      full_audit_ttl_days: 30
      redact_patterns: [ssn, credit_card, api_key]
      audit_quota: tenant_audit_units
```
liam: question: how do we compute prompt_summary safely? are we doing deterministic redact then hash or an abstractive summary?
ana: prefer a two-step: run fast de-identify rules (regexes + entity scanner) -> keep remainder and run small summary model to create 1-2 line summary. store only summary in normal logs
david: summarization still risks leakage (model halluc). keep a HMAC of the original prompt for replay linkage instead of storing the raw text
maya: +1 HMAC approach. also propose a console toggle for temporary inspect (short TTL, requires breakglass role + audit log)
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout: add `preview_fields` parsing to 5% of traffic on prod for 48h, log-level INFO, telemetry flag `structured_whitelist_v1`
liam: metrics we should track during canary: console-preview-error-rate, inspect-unmask-requests, avg-log-size-per-request, backend-cost-per-token-logged
ana: UX: show console preview as collapsed summary with a hover that shows which fields were dropped. make it obvious that full content is audit-only
david: ops note: need retention quotas on the audit silo. otherwise we get bill shock. tie to tenant billing and alert at 80% usage
maya: next steps: 1) feedback on YAML -> iterate rules 2) small PoC in staging for 2 routes (chat, embeddings) 3) canary plan (ops-bot already suggested) 4) doc + console UX mockups
liam: i can take PoC for embeddings route. will sketch extractor and HMAC link flow this week
ana: i'll draft a short privacy-preserving summary pipeline doc and list of redact regexes we should start with
david: i'll add billing + quota hook ups and a runbook for breakglass audit requests
maya: awesome. if nobody objects i'll open a PR with the config schema and PoC ticket tomorrow :thumbsup:
liam: :thumbsup:
